title: Hooked on UFOs by Chariots of the Gods

tellings.quote: you have to go back to 1969, I believe it was. And when when I read um Chariots of the Gods by Eric von Donakin, I was hooked.

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor billed as a NASA doctor who says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar, says he got hooked on UFOs in 1969, as he recalls it, when he read Chariots of the Gods, a book by the writer Erich von Däniken. He tells it as the start of his own lifelong interest.
